business_summary: Pasona Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of human resources consulting, recruitment, temporary staffing, education, training, and contracting and outsourcing services in Japan. The company offers HR and BPO solutions, such as expert services, recruitment, and career support services; business process outsourcing; public solutions; DX promotion services; management and HR consulting; reskilling and business training/next generation leader training; and health management promotion support services. It also provides childcare support; early childhood and child education/human resource development; nursing care facility management; support for balancing work and caregiving; and housekeeping services. In addition, the company offers staffing, recruitment agency, executive search, and job expo; expatriate payroll, establishment of salary regulations, and global personnel system/evaluation system/work regulations; support for expanding overseas bases and business improvement proposals; and mental health care, health management support, and employee benefit services. Further, it is involved in regional revitalization; tourism and sightseeing; restaurant and café; wellness retreat; agriculture; arts and culture/entertainment; and educational community businesses. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
